annotations.text:
Battery as a third ring, nested inside the temperature arc and the warm-up ring the way Activity rings nest.

Off the charger it is a quiet 4 pt line. On the charger it thickens to 10 pt, turns green, and a soft highlight travels around it — motion that means current flowing, not a level changing. Nothing is hidden or rearranged: the steppers, presets and modes stay exactly where they are and grey out, so the screen does not jump when you put it down.
Both frames are the same screen. The only differences: ring thickness and colour, the state label, and the controls' opacity.

Lock Screen, three states of one card.

The question running through all of them: should the three states share one skeleton so the eye learns a single layout (U-A, C-A, S-A), or should each state take the shape that suits it (C-B's battery, S-B's one line)?

Mixing is fine — but a shared skeleton only pays off if you take it in all three.
No buttons on any of these: you said you did not need them, and iOS only allows them from 17 anyway.
